title: FiniteSplitHypercoverReplacement
statement: Let $X$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and let $K$ be an étale hypercover [def-weil-pbc-etale-hypercover]. There is a finite split étale hypercover $V$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover] and a morphism of simplicial étale $X$-schemes $V\to K$ in all degrees.

proof.text: Obtain a finite replacement stage A_0 in degree zero.
For every n choose the successor extension operation on stages through n and its restriction equality. Dependent natural-number recursion constructs a compatible tower A_n starting at A_0.
Apply the proved assembly theorem to this tower to obtain the full finite split hypercover and its simplicial refinement morphism to K.

proof_origin.place: 0DAV: degree zero, finite successor extension, and passage to compatible stages in all degrees. M4 Lean reduction; geometric matching and finite affine cover steps proved.

theorem exists_finite_split_replacement
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (K : SimplicialObject X.Etale) (hK : IsEtaleHypercover K) :
    ∃ V : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X, Nonempty (V.simplicial ⟶ K)
